language.name: English
iblis_headshots.config.title: Iblis Headshots Configuration
iblis_headshots.config.tooltip.general.h: Visual size of the headshot particle effect.
Particle type: 0 = none, 1 = skull, 2 = aim, 3 = star.
iblis_headshots.config.tooltip.general.n: Minimum distance for non-projectile headshots, in blocks.
iblis_headshots.config.tooltip.general.h: Used for player attacks, including PvP; 1.0 keeps normal damage.
iblis_headshots.config.tooltip.general.m: Used when a non-player living entity headshots a player; 1.0 keeps normal damage.
iblis_headshots.config.tooltip.general.h: Durability damage multiplier applied to headgear on a headshot.
iblis_headshots.config.tooltip.general.b: Non-headshot damage multiplier; 1.0 keeps normal damage.
iblis_headshots.config.tooltip.general.p: Chance that a head hit on a player counts as a headshot; 1.0 = 100%.
If enabled, the chance also applies to PvP; otherwise PvP head hits always count.
iblis_headshots.config.tooltip.general.h: Only IDs in config/iblis/headshot_entity_whitelist.txt receive headshots; this overrides the blacklist.
IDs in config/iblis/headshot_entity_blacklist.txt cannot receive headshots; ignored while the whitelist is enabled.
iblis_headshots.config.tooltip.general.p: Use TACZ's native headshot damage only. Iblis lists, chance and counters still apply.
